tools.name: become_a_dietitian
tools.description: Open information for registered dietitians who want to join Nourish. Use when the user is a dietitian (RD/RDN) interested in working with Nourish, estimating pay, or applying.

page.description: Which page to open. Defaults to overview.

tools.name: book_first_appointment
tools.description: Start booking a first appointment with a Nourish registered dietitian: sign up, verify insurance coverage, and schedule a virtual visit. Sessions are covered by most major insurance plans, often at $0 out of pocket. Use when the user wants to book, sign up, get started, or check their coverage and price.

tools.name: check_insurance_coverage
tools.description: Open the Nourish coverage page for a specific insurer, or the general "Am I covered?" page if no insurer is given. Use when the user asks whether their insurance covers a dietitian or nutrition counseling.

insurer.description: Insurance carrier. Omit if unknown or not listed.

tools.name: view_condition_page
tools.description: Open Nourish's page for a specific condition, describing how registered dietitians treat it and how to get covered care. Use when the user asks about nutrition support for a condition like diabetes, PCOS, IBS, eating disorders, GLP-1 medications, or gut health.

condition.description: Condition identifier. Must be one of the listed values.

tools.name: view_faq
tools.description: Open the Nourish FAQ covering insurance, appointments, pricing, and how care works. Use for general questions not covered by a more specific tool.

tools.name: view_patient_outcomes
tools.description: Open Nourish's clinical outcomes page with data from its nutrition programs. Use when the user asks whether Nourish works, wants evidence, results, or clinical outcomes.

tools.name: view_success_stories
tools.description: Open real patient success stories. Use when the user asks for reviews, testimonials, patient experiences, or social proof.
